RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your longer experience matters, but years alone don’t establish who best met the criteria; digital expertise, leadership and interview performance may have carried weight.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them and the expected response date.

Raise a discrimination concern if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related remarks, inconsistent scoring or departures from the advertised criteria—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If you might challenge the appointment, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for an explanation may not extend them.
